# GET /api/v1/users/search

Search for users by keyword, uid, with pagination

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** none (public endpoint, but results vary by auth status) · **ID:** `ep-123`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| q | query | string | False |
| uid | query | integer (int64) | False |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

## Response

**200** — object

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `ok` | boolean | Always true on success |
| `data` | []api.User | Array of user objects |

- **500** — Database error during search

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.Search | controller | Parse pagination options; Parse uid param; Handle special user IDs (ghost/actions); Call SearchUsers; Set link/count headers; Convert to API users |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | utils.GetListOptions | utility | Parse page param (min 1); Parse limit param via ToCorrectPageSize |
| 3 | [models](../modules/models.md) | user_model.SearchUsers | repository | Build search condition with keyword LIKE on lower_name/full_name/email; Apply visibility filter; Apply BuildCanSeeUserCondition; Count total results; Apply pagination; Execute query with SELECT user.* |
| 4 | [services](../modules/services.md) | convert.ToUsers | utility | Iterate users; Convert each to API User struct; Apply privacy rules for email visibility |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| User search results are filtered by visibility: anonymous users only see public users, restricted users only see public, non-restricted see public+limited | authorization | actor == nil || actor.IsRestricted || !actor.IsAdmin |
| Special user IDs (GhostUser=-1, ActionsUser=-2) return synthetic user objects without DB query | business_logic | uid == user_model.GhostUserID || uid == user_model.ActionsUserID |
| Email search is restricted: non-admin users can only find users by email if keep_email_private is false, or if searching for themselves | authorization | opts.SearchByEmail && opts.Actor != nil && !opts.Actor.IsAdmin |
| Email is hidden when user has KeepEmailPrivate=true, unless viewer is authed (self or admin) | business_logic | signed && (!user.KeepEmailPrivate || authed) |
